applicability: Retaining a live leaf comparison for subsequent historical review.
conditions: Ordinary curation invokes the shipped comparison producer with an admitted, coherently composed source and knowledge pair.
The freeze owner retains and validates every referenced operand before publishing its per-leaf generation.
exclusions: A leaf that never recorded a generation may only reconstruct its exact recorded endpoints with that provenance stated.
This is not evidence that a task published the knowledge it reviewed or that its final output matches the review.
One generation binds one recorded comparison; later explicit recordings may create successor generations for the same leaf.
statement: A leaf's review comparison is recorded as one durable per-leaf generation through the freeze owner rather than recomposed per reader, so the comparison a reviewer read while the enclosure was live resolves from its own record after the leaf closes instead of falling back to a bare recorded source range.
